accounting_rules.external_procurement: Charge once when units enter the supplier from an external source; never on internal transfers.
accounting_rules.holding: Charge closing on-hand units at every node once per day.
accounting_rules.orders: Charge fixed order cost only for actual positive replenishment orders.
accounting_rules.shortage: Charge only unfulfilled terminal consumer demand as lost sales; upstream unfilled requests are not additional lost sales.
accounting_rules.transport: Charge variable cost per dispatched unit and fixed cost per actual dispatch.
